# Steel widget, 40 millimetre

**£19.99**

Material: hardened steel
Mass: 212 g

Machined from one billet, so there is no seam to work loose.

In stock. Ships the same day if ordered before two.

Press it in cold and support the far face while you do.

Torque the retaining screw to nine newton metres and no further.

Trade accounts: five boxes or more, call the number below.
Carriage is free on trade orders over two hundred pounds.

# Brass widget, 40 millimetre

**£19.99**

Material: free cutting brass
Mass: 231 g

Softer than the steel and quieter in a housing that already rattles.

In stock. Ships the same day if ordered before two.

It will not take the same load. Half of it, as a rule of thumb.

Machines beautifully if you are cutting your own housing to suit.

Trade accounts: five boxes or more, call the number below.
Carriage is free on trade orders over two hundred pounds.

Clearance: last of this batch, no reorder planned.
Sold as seen. The sixty day return still applies.

# Nylon widget, 32 millimetre

**£19.99**

Material: glass filled nylon
Mass: 38 g

For the places where a metal widget would weld itself to the shaft.

In stock. Ships the same day if ordered before two.

It grows a little in the wet, so fit it at the loose end of tolerance.

Cheap enough to treat as a wear part and replace on a schedule.

Trade accounts: five boxes or more, call the number below.
Carriage is free on trade orders over two hundred pounds.

Clearance: last of this batch, no reorder planned.
Sold as seen. The sixty day return still applies.

# Steel widget, 32 millimetre

**£19.99**

Material: hardened steel

The same part as the forty in every way except the diameter.

In stock. Ships the same day if ordered before two.

The fitting sleeve is different. Ordering the wrong one is the common mistake.

Torque to seven newton metres, not nine.

Trade accounts: five boxes or more, call the number below.
Carriage is free on trade orders over two hundred pounds.

Clearance: last of this batch, no reorder planned.

# Bronze widget, 40 millimetre

**£19.99**

Material: phosphor bronze
Mass: 244 g

The one to use against a steel shaft you do not want to score.

In stock. Ships the same day if ordered before two.

It beds in over the first few hours and then holds where it is.

Expensive, and worth it on a shaft that is expensive to replace.

# Steel widget, 50 millimetre

**£19.99**

Material: hardened steel
Mass: 387 g

The largest we make in one piece. Above this it is a two part assembly.

In stock. Ships the same day if ordered before two.

Heating the housing does make sense at this size, unlike the smaller ones.

Torque to fourteen newton metres.
